edits.text: Speiche bike workshop, Leipzig
A small workshop that takes every bike seriously.
Four mechanics, one workshop and a simple promise: we fix the cause and tell you the price first.
Write to the workshop
Call the workshop
Two mechanics started Speiche in 2014.
We opened the workshop because we wanted to repair bikes properly instead of selling new ones.
Today four people work at Karl-Liebknecht-Strasse 12, all of them trained mechanics.
We keep the workshop small on purpose, so the person who checks your bike is the one who repairs it.
That is also why we can promise a repair within 24 hours for most jobs.
We find the cause before we change a part.
A squeaking chain can be a worn chain, a bent derailleur hanger or a loose bottom bracket.
So every bike gets a full check first, and you hear what we found before we start.
You agree to a fixed price, and that price does not change.
How a repair works, in four steps
Book
Write or call us with a short description of the problem and the address for pick-up.
Pick-up
We collect the bike at the agreed time anywhere in Leipzig and take it to the workshop.
Check and repair
A mechanic checks the bike, names the fixed price and repairs it once you agree.
Delivery
Within 24 hours the bike is back at your door, checked and ready to ride.
Contact
Talk to the mechanic who will fix your bike.
No call centre and no ticket queue. Write or call and a mechanic answers.
Write to workshop@example.org
Visit us at Karl-Liebknecht-Strasse 12, 04107 Leipzig
Open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 18:00.
